label: Graphite & Emerald
description: Deep graphite with a restrained emerald accent on a near-white page. Sober and credible — suits chartered accountants, tax and financial consultants, legal and advisory firms.
notes: Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables. Deliberately sober: money advice is bought on trust, and a bright palette reads promotional rather than professional. Emerald is used sparingly for calls to action only.
